title: Yellow Glazed British Lamb Sunday Roast
description: A funky and gooey British dish featuring yuzu and pickle, perfect for a special occasion, this low-glycemic-friendly recipe is served in a tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Add the yuzu juice, pickle juice, and honey to the vessel.
Add the garlic and rosemary to the vessel.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 2.5 hours or until the meat is tender.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Slice the lamb and serve with the yellow glaze spooned over the top.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
